I apologize if this becomes one long run on sentence, but as someone who's tried to dabble in a bit of everything while lurking here I have some things I want to respond with.

I won't discard your reservations as entirely baseless or without merit. There may indeed be a higher percentage of vitriolic based subverses here than there are subreddits. However, I think that's an absolutely FANTASTIC thing.

Sounds weird, on the surface, but bear with me. The reason Voat is booming is in large part due to the recent SJW and PCness of Reddit. People are being banned for no reason, or for having opinions people may not agree with. Subreddits are having all their imgur images deleted by imgur (sister site of reddit as you well know), etc.

The fact that those types of people can be safe to have their opinions here shows that this isn't going to be an echo chamber, it won't be a bastion of self pity and circlejerking, it won't be a hovel full of people who want the warm fuzzies all the time. It'll be real, and sometimes reality is ugly. Sometimes voat will be ugly. Especially in it's infancy when the biggest need for a place like this is for those that have opinions they can't share on Reddit.

Give it time, and it'll grow.

I have started moderating the types of subverses that I personally think may be a bit ugly, because I want to know right away if any freedom of speech is being infringed on, and want to keep things just safe enough to not have legal problems for the owner. Swiss law is more forgiving in many ways than American law, but it's not anarchy.

My first day here I had great political discussions with people that stayed very respectful though we were fundamentally at disagreement.

Then I applied to get ownership of /v/jailbait and the response was less than enthusiastic both from the people who hate the idea, and those who love it, because one side thought jailbait should be banned entirely, the other thought I was being a nazi for wanting to prevent child pornography.

There's going to be good and bad, any growing child has growing pains, but when you grow the foundation is everything. We're here, together, building a house, and the foundation is concrete, not wood, and if we keep it in check we won't get termites burrowing in and ruining it down the road a la reddit.

Welcome to Voat, voice your opinions loudly, start a subverse, post content, build the site you want to see.
